note: Stylesheets without any rule are emitted empty instead of as a bare license banner, so the empty shared base sheet no longer repeats the banner in every per-file stylesheet that imports it. The banner names the version without a trailing comma (`v1.0.83`, not `v1.0.83,`). A new `licenseBanner` plugin option (default `true`) and the `setLicenseBanner`/`isLicenseBanner` engine functions turn the banner off; both engines emit identical output.
